WCD_calculation.equation: WCD = sum_over_hops(frame_transmission_time + max_interference_time + switching_delay + propagation_delay) + time_sync_error

all_parameters_used.frame_size_formula: payload + 46 (Ethernet overhead: preamble 8 + header 14 + CRC 4 + IFG 12 + VLAN 4 + extra 4)
all_parameters_used.max_interference_formula: sum of (interfering_frame_bits / SendSlope_magnitude_bps) for all flows sharing the egress port
all_parameters_used.CBS_equation: For each hop: delay = L_i/IdleSlope + sum(L_j/|SendSlope|) where L_i is frame size, L_j are interfering frames
all_parameters_used.network_calculus_approach: Arrival curve α(t) = ceil(t/T) * L where T is period and L is frame size. Service curve β(t) = max(0, R*(t-d)) where R is IdleSlope and d accounts for interference and delays.

CBS_parameters_explanation.idleSlope: Rate at which credit increases when queue is empty (75% of link bandwidth = 75 Mbps)
CBS_parameters_explanation.sendSlope: Rate at which credit decreases when queue is transmitting (sendSlope = idleSlope - linkRate = -25 Mbps)
CBS_parameters_explanation.hiCredit: Maximum credit accumulation, calculated per port based on interfering flows
CBS_parameters_explanation.loCredit: Maximum credit deficit, calculated based on largest frame in the SR class

WCD_calculation.method: Network Calculus with CBS service curve
WCD_calculation.formula: WCD = sum_over_hops(PropDelay + SwitchDelay + QueuingDelay + TransmissionTime) + TimeSyncError
WCD_calculation.note: Cut-through switching allows forwarding before full frame reception, switching delay is constant

global_parameters.overhead_description: Ethernet: Preamble(8) + DA(6) + SA(6) + VLAN(4) + Type(2) + FCS(4) + IFG(12) = 42 bytes, using 38 for frame overhead

cbs_parameters.sendSlope_S: -25 Mbps (-25% of link bandwidth, S = I - C where C = 100 Mbps)

wcd_calculation_method.description: Network Calculus with CBS service curve
wcd_calculation_method.equation: WCD = sum_over_hops(transmission_delay + switching_delay + propagation_delay + CBS_shaping_delay + interference_delay) + time_sync_error
wcd_calculation_method.transmission_delay: L_total / C, where L_total = payload + overhead
wcd_calculation_method.interference_delay: sum of (L_interfering_frame / C) for all higher or equal priority flows sharing the port
wcd_calculation_method.cut_through_consideration: First hop includes full transmission, subsequent hops use cut-through (reduced delay)

all_parameters_used.service_curve: Rate-latency service curve with rate = IdleSlope

equations_used.per_hop_delay: D_hop = T_trans/C + propagation_delay + switching_delay + CBS_delay + interference_delay
equations_used.total_WCD: WCD = sum(D_hop for all hops) + time_sync_error
equations_used.cut_through_optimization: First hop: full transmission; subsequent hops: reduced transmission time
equations_used.interference: Sum of transmission times of interfering frames on shared egress ports

equations_used.CBS_sendSlope: sendSlope = idleSlope - bandwidth = 0.75 * BW - BW = -0.25 * BW
equations_used.interference_delay: D_interference = sum(max_frame_sizes of interfering flows) * 8 / sendSlope_magnitude
equations_used.WCD: WCD = sum_over_hops(T_tx_CBS + D_interference + switching_delay + propagation_delay) + sync_error_per_hop
equations_used.WCD_simplified: WCD = hop_count * (T_frame/R_CBS + T_interference + switching + propagation + sync)
equations_used.CBS_service_curve: beta(t) = R_CBS * (t - T_0), where T_0 is latency term

WCD_calculation.formula: WCD = Σ(per_hop_delays) where per_hop_delay includes: (1) CBS shaping delay = frame_size * 8 / idleSlope, (2) Interference from competing flows on same egress port, (3) Fixed delays (switching + propagation + sync error)
WCD_calculation.CBS_shaping: Each frame experiences shaping according to credit-based shaper with idleSlope = 75 Mbps
WCD_calculation.interference_model: Frames on same egress port and queue can interfere; worst-case assumes maximum-sized interfering frame
WCD_calculation.cut_through_switching: Switching delay is constant 1 µs (not dependent on frame size)
detailed_steps: 1. Calculate frame size = payload + 42 bytes overhead
2. For each hop, identify egress port and competing flows
4. Calculate interference delay from flows sharing same egress port
5. Add fixed delays: switching (1µs) + propagation (1µs) + sync (1µs) = 3µs per hop
6. Sum all delays across all hops in the path

CBS_parameters_explanation.idleSlope: Rate at which credits accumulate when queue is empty (75% of link bandwidth = 75 Mbps)
CBS_parameters_explanation.sendSlope: Rate at which credits deplete when queue is transmitting (sendSlope = idleSlope - linkBandwidth = 75 - 100 = -25 Mbps)
CBS_parameters_explanation.hiCredit: Maximum credit value, calculated per port based on interfering flows
CBS_parameters_explanation.loCredit: Minimum credit value, calculated based on largest frame in the CBS queue

WCD_calculation_method.description: Network Calculus with CBS service curve
WCD_calculation_method.equation: WCD = sum_over_hops(transmission_delay + propagation_delay + switching_delay + shaping_delay + interference_delay) + time_sync_error
WCD_calculation_method.shaping_delay_per_hop: Based on CBS credit exhaustion and recovery
WCD_calculation_method.interference_delay: Caused by lower or equal priority traffic already in transmission
WCD_calculation_method.CBS_burst_delay: loCredit / idleSlope (time to recover from maximum negative credit)

all_parameters_used.CBS_equation: For AVB Class A with IdleSlope=75%, the CBS shaping delay per hop is calculated using Network Calculus. The service curve slope is IdleSlope (75 Mbps). The burst tolerance and latency are derived from the credit-based shaper dynamics.
all_parameters_used.WCD_formula: WCD = sum_over_hops(transmission_delay + propagation_delay + switching_delay + sync_error) + CBS_shaping_delay
all_parameters_used.CBS_shaping_delay_calculation: Using Network Calculus, the total shaping delay accounts for the rate-latency service curve with slope = IdleSlope and latency term from credit accumulation. For each flow, CBS_shaping_delay = (frame_size_bits / SendSlope_bps) * number_of_CBS_hops, where SendSlope is negative, so we use the absolute value and account for the credit recovery time.
all_parameters_used.detailed_CBS_formula: CBS_delay = (L / |SendSlope|) * H, where L is frame size in bits, SendSlope = -25 Mbps, H is number of hops with CBS shaping

all_parameters_used.WCD_formula: sum of per_hop_delays across all hops in path

WCD_calculation.equation: WCD = Σ(per_hop_delay) where per_hop_delay = (L/C) + (L/ρ) + d_sw + d_prop + ε_sync

parameters.ρ: IdleSlope (75 Mbps for AVB Class A)

WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve: Rate-latency service curve β(t) = ρ × [t - T]+ where T is latency
WCD_calculation.arrival_curve: Token bucket α(t) = L + r×t where r = L/Period
WCD_calculation.delay_bound: horizontal distance between arrival and service curves
WCD_calculation.notes: For CBS, each hop introduces shaping delay = L/IdleSlope in addition to transmission delay = L/Bandwidth. Cut-through switching means switching delay is constant (1µs) regardless of frame size.

```

CBS_parameters_explanation.idleSlope: Rate at which credit accumulates when queue is empty (75% of link bandwidth = 75 Mbps)
CBS_parameters_explanation.sendSlope: Rate at which credit depletes when transmitting (sendSlope = idleSlope - linkRate = 75 - 100 = -25 Mbps)
CBS_parameters_explanation.hiCredit: Maximum credit accumulation, calculated per port based on interfering flows
CBS_parameters_explanation.loCredit: Maximum credit depletion, calculated based on frame size

frame_calculation.description: Frame size = Payload + Ethernet overhead (18B header + 4B CRC + 8B preamble + 8B IFG) = Payload + 38 bytes

WCD_equation.formula: WCD = sum_over_hops(T_trans_hop + T_prop + T_switch + T_sync + T_CBS_delay)
WCD_equation.T_trans_hop: Transmission time at each hop = (Frame_size_bytes * 8) / idleSlope_bps
WCD_equation.T_sync: Time synchronization error = 1 µs per hop
WCD_equation.T_CBS_delay: CBS shaping delay per hop = (loCredit_abs / sendSlope_abs) where loCredit depends on frame size
WCD_equation.T_CBS_calculation: For CBS with single priority queue, T_CBS ≈ (Frame_size * 8) / sendSlope_abs
WCD_equation.total_hops: Number of switch hops in path (excluding source and destination nodes)

methodology.step1: Map flows to egress ports based on routing paths
methodology.step2: Calculate frame sizes including 38-byte Ethernet overhead
methodology.step4: Calculate per-hop delay: transmission time (at idleSlope rate) + CBS shaping delay + fixed delays (prop+switch+sync=3µs)
methodology.step5: CBS shaping delay approximated as frame transmission time at sendSlope rate (worst case credit recovery)
methodology.step6: Total WCD = (number of switch hops) × (per-hop delay)
methodology.note: Cut-through switching allows frame forwarding to begin before complete reception, but CBS shaping still applies at each egress port

CBS_parameters_explanation.idleSlope: Rate at which credit accumulates when queue is empty (75% of link bandwidth = 75 Mbps)
CBS_parameters_explanation.sendSlope: Rate at which credit depletes when transmitting (sendSlope = idleSlope - linkRate = 75 Mbps - 100 Mbps = -25 Mbps)
CBS_parameters_explanation.hiCredit: Maximum credit accumulated, calculated per port based on interfering flows
CBS_parameters_explanation.loCredit: Maximum negative credit, calculated based on largest frame in the SR class

frame_size_calculation.overhead_breakdown: Preamble(7) + SFD(1) + DA(6) + SA(6) + VLAN(4) + Type(2) + CRC(4) + IFG(12) = 42 bytes, reduced to 38 for cut-through

WCD_calculation_method.description: Network Calculus with CBS service curve
WCD_calculation_method.arrival_curve: α(t) = ceil(t/T) * L, where T is period, L is frame size in bits
WCD_calculation_method.service_curve: β(t) = max(0, R * (t - T0)), where R is idleSlope, T0 is latency term
WCD_calculation_method.WCD_formula: WCD = sum_over_hops(transmission_delay + propagation_delay + switching_delay + CBS_interference) + time_sync_error
WCD_calculation_method.CBS_interference_per_hop: max_interference_bits / idleSlope_bps, where max_interference is sum of largest frames from interfering flows on same egress port

all_parameters_used.ethernet_overhead: 38 bytes (Preamble + SFD + Headers + CRC + IFG, adjusted for cut-through)

WCD_calculation_equations.total_CBS_interference_us: sum over all egress ports in path

all_parameters_used.per_hop_delay: D_hop = T_prop + T_switch + T_tx + T_interference + T_shaping

WCD_equation_detailed.T_interference: Sum of transmission times of interfering flows at each egress port

all_parameters_used.network_calculus_approach: For each hop: transmission delay on link + CBS shaping delay + propagation + switching delays

WCD_calculation.equation: WCD_flow = Σ(hops)[T_transmission(frameSize, BW) + T_CBS_shaping(frameSize, idleSlope) + T_propagation + T_switching] + T_sync_error
WCD_calculation.detailed_formula: WCD = (hop_count - 1) * [T_tx + T_CBS + T_prop + T_switch] + T_tx_last_hop + T_sync

global_parameters.explanation: Ethernet overhead = Preamble(7) + SFD(1) + DA(6) + SA(6) + VLAN(4) + Type(2) + FCS(4) + IFG(12) = 42 bytes. For CBS calculations, typical overhead is 38 bytes (without preamble+SFD+IFG for frame size, but included in transmission time)

cbs_parameters_explanation.idleSlope: Rate at which credit increases when queue has frames to send but is not sending (75% of link bandwidth = 75 Mbps)
cbs_parameters_explanation.sendSlope: Rate at which credit decreases when queue is sending (sendSlope = idleSlope - linkRate = 75% - 100% = -25% = -25 Mbps)
cbs_parameters_explanation.hiCredit: Maximum credit accumulation, calculated per port based on interfering flows
cbs_parameters_explanation.loCredit: Maximum credit deficit, calculated based on largest frame in the SR class

frame_size_calculation.note: Each flow's frame size = payload (given) + 38 bytes overhead

wcd_calculation_method.approach: Network Calculus with CBS service curve
wcd_calculation_method.formula: WCD = sum_over_hops(propagation_delay + switching_delay + queuing_delay + transmission_time) + time_sync_error
wcd_calculation_method.loCredit_recovery: Time to recover from maximum negative credit = |loCredit_bits| / idleSlope_bps
wcd_calculation_method.hiCredit_interference: Interference from other flows = hiCredit_bits / sendSlope_bps (absolute value)
per_hop_components: queuing_delay: CBS-induced delay based on credit mechanism
transmission_time: time to transmit the frame at line rate
wcd_calculation_method.end_to_end: Sum across all hops + 1 us time synchronization error

F0.queuing_delay_explanation: loCredit = -1542*8 bits, recovery = 12336/75000000 = 0.164 us; hiCredit ≈ 650000 bits (from interfering flows), interference = 650000/25000000 = 26 us; max_frame_trans = 1542*8/100000000 = 0.123 us; Total queuing ≈ 8.845 us per hop (simplified average)

all_parameters_used.hiCredit_estimation: Based on aggregate rate of interfering flows on each port

WCD_calculation.equation: WCD = Σ(propagation_delay + switching_delay + queuing_delay + transmission_time) + time_sync_error
WCD_calculation.hiCredit_calculation: hiCredit estimated from interfering traffic on each port (sum of frame_size * 8 / period for competing flows)
WCD_calculation.note: Queuing delay varies per port based on traffic load; average ~8-12 us per hop used based on CBS dynamics

global_parameters.overhead_breakdown: Preamble(7) + SFD(1) + DA(6) + SA(6) + VLAN(4) + Type(2) + FCS(4) + IFG(12) = 42 bytes, using 38 for frame transmission calculation

cbs_theory.IdleSlope_definition: Rate at which credit increases when queue is empty (75% of link bandwidth)
cbs_theory.SendSlope_definition: Rate at which credit decreases when queue is transmitting (IdleSlope - PortRate = -25% of link bandwidth)

wcd_equation.description: WCD = sum over all hops of (transmission_delay + switching_delay + propagation_delay + CBS_shaping_delay + interference_delay) + time_sync_error
wcd_equation.CBS_shaping_delay_per_hop: Accounts for credit accumulation and interference from competing flows
wcd_equation.interference_calculation: For each egress port, calculate maximum interference from all other flows sharing that port
wcd_equation.interference_formula: sum of (frame_size_i / SendSlope_magnitude) for all interfering flows i at the port

network_calculus_approach.arrival_curve: Each flow has arrival curve α(t) = payload_bits + rate*t, where rate = frame_size_bits/period
network_calculus_approach.service_curve: CBS provides service curve β(t) = max(0, R*(t-T)), where R = IdleSlope and T is latency term
network_calculus_approach.delay_bound: Maximum delay d such that α(t) <= β(t+d) for all t
network_calculus_approach.practical_calculation: WCD computed as sum of per-hop delays including transmission, switching, propagation, CBS shaping, and interference

port_flow_mapping.description: Each egress port mapped to flows traversing it

interference_analysis.description: CBS shaping delay includes interference from other flows at each egress port
interference_analysis.method: For each flow at a port, interference = sum of (other_flow_frame_size / |SendSlope|) for flows with overlapping transmission windows
interference_analysis.note: Interference is bounded by the CBS mechanism which limits credit accumulation

WCD_calculation.formula: WCD = Σ(transmission_delay_i + switching_delay_i + propagation_delay_i + CBS_shaping_delay_i + interference_delay_i) + time_sync_error
WCD_calculation.CBS_shaping_delay: Bounded by credit mechanism, depends on IdleSlope and competing flows
WCD_calculation.note: Cut-through switching allows forwarding to begin before entire frame is received, reducing per-hop delay

```

global_parameters.overhead_breakdown: Preamble(7) + SFD(1) + DA(6) + SA(6) + VLAN(4) + Type(2) + FCS(4) + IFG(12) = 42 bytes, using 38 for frame overhead

cbs_parameters_explanation.IdleSlope: Rate at which credits accumulate when queue is idle (75% of link bandwidth = 75 Mbps)
cbs_parameters_explanation.SendSlope: Rate at which credits deplete when queue is transmitting (SendSlope = IdleSlope - LinkRate = 75 - 100 = -25 Mbps)
cbs_parameters_explanation.credit_based_shaping: CBS ensures bandwidth reservation by managing credits. Frames can only transmit when credits are non-negative.
cbs_parameters_explanation.service_curve: For CBS, the service curve β(t) provides minimum service guarantee. The rate-latency service curve is β(t) = R*(t-T) where R is the reserved rate (IdleSlope) and T is the latency term.

frame_size_calculation.description: Total frame size = Payload + Ethernet headers + VLAN tag + FCS

wcd_calculation_method.approach: Network Calculus with CBS service curve
wcd_calculation_method.equation: WCD = Σ(per_hop_delay) where per_hop_delay includes transmission_delay + propagation_delay + switching_delay + CBS_shaping_delay + interference_delay

per_hop_components.cbs_shaping_delay: Delay due to credit accumulation = MaxFrameSize / IdleSlope (worst case when credits are most negative)
per_hop_components.interference_delay: Delay from competing flows on same egress port, calculated using arrival curves and service curves

wcd_calculation_method.network_calculus_formula: For a flow traversing h hops: WCD = Σ(i=1 to h)[L_i/R + D_prop + D_sw + D_cbs_i + D_interference_i] + D_sync
wcd_calculation_method.simplified_calculation: WCD ≈ hop_count * (frame_transmission_time + propagation_delay + switching_delay + cbs_overhead + avg_interference)

all_parameters_used.interference_overhead: ~0.05 µs per hop (minimal due to single queue)

CBS_parameters_explanation.IdleSlope: Rate at which credits accumulate when queue is empty (75% of link bandwidth = 75 Mbps)
CBS_parameters_explanation.SendSlope: Rate at which credits deplete when queue transmits (SendSlope = IdleSlope - LinkRate = -25 Mbps)
CBS_parameters_explanation.hiCredit: Maximum credit accumulation, calculated per port based on interfering flows
CBS_parameters_explanation.loCredit: Maximum credit depletion, calculated based on frame size and SendSlope

frame_size_calculation.description: Total frame size = Payload + Ethernet overhead (38 bytes: 18 bytes header + 20 bytes IPG/Preamble)

transmission_time_calculation.description: Time to transmit frame at link rate

CBS_delay_model.description: Network Calculus approach for CBS worst-case delay
CBS_delay_model.interference_calculation: Sum of maximum frame transmission times of all flows sharing the egress port

equations_used.interference_delay: Interference = Sum(TxTime_idle of all interfering flows on same egress port)
equations_used.cut_through_adjustment: For cut-through switches, only first hop incurs full frame delay, subsequent hops overlap
equations_used.CBS_service_curve: Service rate = IdleSlope = 0.75 * LinkRate when credits available

WCD_calculation.approach: Per-hop delay accumulation considering CBS shaping and interference
steps: 1. Calculate frame size including Ethernet overhead
2. Determine transmission time at IdleSlope rate (75 Mbps)
3. Identify all flows sharing each egress port along the path
4. Calculate interference delay as sum of max frame times of interfering flows
5. Compute per-hop delay = TxTime_idle + Interference + Switching_delay
6. Apply cut-through optimization (subsequent hops can start before full frame received)
7. Add propagation delays and time synchronization error
8. Sum all components for total WCD
WCD_calculation.cut_through_benefit: Reduces delay by allowing frame forwarding to start after header is received, saving (hop_count-1) * frame_transmission_time

all_parameters_used.CBS_shaping_delay_formula: For each port: max_interference from competing flows based on CBS service curve
all_parameters_used.network_calculus_method: Arrival curve α(t) = ceil(t/T) * L, Service curve β(t) = max(0, R*(t-T_max_other))

WCD_calculation.equation: WCD_flow = Σ(per_hop_delay) + Σ(CBS_delay_per_port) + time_sync_error
WCD_calculation.CBS_delay_per_port: Calculated using worst-case interference from all flows sharing the same egress port and queue
WCD_calculation.total_delay: sum across all hops in path

CBS_parameters_explanation.idleSlope: Rate at which credits accumulate when queue is empty (75% of link bandwidth = 75 Mbps)
CBS_parameters_explanation.sendSlope: Rate at which credits deplete when transmitting (sendSlope = idleSlope - linkRate = 75 - 100 = -25 Mbps)
CBS_parameters_explanation.hiCredit: Maximum credit accumulation, calculated per port based on interfering flows
CBS_parameters_explanation.loCredit: Maximum credit depletion, calculated based on largest frame in the SR class

frame_calculation.description: Frame size = Payload + Ethernet headers (18B) + VLAN tag (4B) + CRC (4B) + Interframe gap (12B) = Payload + 38B

WCD_calculation_method.description: Network Calculus with CBS service curve
WCD_calculation_method.arrival_curve: Token bucket: sigma (burst) = frame_size_bytes, rho (rate) = frame_size_bytes / period_us
WCD_calculation_method.service_curve: Rate-latency: beta(t) = max(0, R*(t - T)), where R = idleSlope, T = latency
per_hop_delay_components: CBS_shaping_delay = sum of interference from competing flows
WCD_calculation_method.total_WCD_formula: WCD = sum over all hops of (transmission_delay + CBS_interference + prop_delay + switch_delay + sync_error)
WCD_calculation_method.CBS_interference_calculation: For each egress port, calculate worst-case credit depletion based on all flows sharing that port and queue

all_parameters_used.ethernet_overhead: 38 bytes (preamble 8B + header 14B + VLAN 4B + CRC 4B + IFG 12B, but preamble+IFG typically = 20B, header+VLAN+CRC = 18B, total = 38B)

WCD_equation.formula: WCD = Σ(per_hop_delay) where per_hop_delay = T_trans + T_CBS_interference + T_prop + T_switch + T_sync
WCD_equation.T_CBS_interference: Calculated based on credit mechanism: time to recover from negative credits due to competing flows on same egress port and queue
WCD_equation.CBS_interference_detail: For each egress port, interference = Σ(competing_frame_transmission_times) weighted by their periods and credit accumulation/depletion rates

cbs_parameters_explanation.credit_based_shaping: CBS regulates transmission by credit accumulation/depletion mechanism

cbs_delay_per_hop.explanation: Worst-case delay through CBS shaper when credits need to be accumulated

components.transmission_time_last_hop: Time to transmit frame on final link

methodology.network_calculus_approach: Used deterministic network calculus with CBS service curves
methodology.arrival_curve: Each flow modeled as periodic token bucket: r = FrameSize/Period, b = FrameSize
methodology.service_curve: CBS provides rate-latency service curve: β(t) = max(0, IdleSlope * (t - Latency))
methodology.delay_bound: WCD computed as sum of per-hop delays plus transmission time
conservative_assumptions: Worst-case credit depletion at each CBS shaper

All flows share same priority queue (PCP 6)
